description: pave-init hooks that must reach subagents or survive compaction. A skill-frontmatter hook fires only for the agent that invoked the skill, so the planning-layout warning (node planners write planning/), the write-for-the-reader reminder, and the goal restatement (SessionStart resume|compact for the lead, SubagentStart for every seat) register here. All are armed by the .pave-init-run marker and stay silent outside an active run. The stop check and the staleness reminder are lead-only and stay in the skill's frontmatter.
